text:
Nora T.: Heads-up: were deprecating the runnable inline code snippets in the public SDK docs (the green "run" buttons) in favor of pre-generated, tested examples and a single official CLI devkit. Reason: inline sandboxes cause flaky telemetry and stale examples. :information_source:
Ethan R.: ouch, any user-facing fallout?
Nora T.: Short answer: most users wont notice. Were replacing the widgets with code blocks + copy buttons and providing a `redwood-samples` repo with runnable examples and a lightweight CLI (`rw-examples`) that can fetch and run the canonical snippets locally.
Sophie G.: timeline?
Nora T.: Deprecation notice goes live today. Docs will switch widgets -> static code blocks next Wednesday (UTC). `rw-examples` v1 will ship at the same time. Full removal of the backend sandbox and telemetry will occur 60 days after the switch.
docs-bot: Deprecation doc + migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/snippet-deprecation (includes sample migration script and CLI usage)
Ethan R.: migration help for customer-facing guides (tutorials)?
Nora T.: We built a tiny codemod: `docs-snippet-freeze` to export runnable state to the repo and a GitHub Action to validate examples on CI. Run `npx docs-snippet-freeze ./content --out=rw-samples` to extract.
cli-bot: CLI quickstart: `npm i -g @redwood/rw-examples` then `rw-examples run hello-world --lang=python`
Sophie G.: will existing embedded snippets still run during the overlap?
Nora T.: Yes, theres a 2-week overlap window where the sandbox remains live for enterprise customers who ask for an extension. After that we shut down the sandbox and keep the static blocks + sample repo.
Ethan R.: any analytics change or telemetry opt-outs we should tell customers about?
ora t.: Were turning off code-execution telemetry by default. The sample repo and CLI can opt-in to anonymous run counts for maintainers; customers will be asked to opt-in explicitly if they want telemetry. No payloads or keys are collected.
Sophie G.: CI recommendations for docs owners?
ora t.: Add `rw-examples` smoke tests in CI: `rw-examples validate --path=docs/examples --matrix=python,node` and enable the GH Action we published to fail when examples diverge. Docs playbook includes a sample workflow.
Ethan R.: who do teams ping if snippets break during the transition?
Nora T.: Ping me (@nora) or @ethan on #docs and open a PR in `docs-infra` with label `snippet-deprec`. We'll triage fast.
Sophie G.: TL;DR?
Nora T.: 1) Widgets -> static code blocks next Wed 2) `rw-examples` + `docs-snippet-freeze` available at release 3) Sandbox turned off after 60 days (2-week overlap possible for select customers) 4) Opt-in telemetry only 5) Ping #docs for help.
docs-bot: Migration guide + codemod + CLI: https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/snippet-deprecation#migration
Nora T.: Thanks folks 44d Ill post the docs PR shortly and the samples repo link after CI passes.
